_comment: Manually authored per-image layout. Every coordinate here was chosen by looking at that specific photo's actual negative space (see the crops taken during authoring) — nothing here is computed by the renderer. x/y are the top-left corner of each element's visual box (not an SVG baseline). Only images with an entry here can be rendered; render.mjs fails for any image id missing from this file.

MOL_IMG_001._rationale: Jute rug is the only clean negative space on this photo. y=1065 is verified clear of the hip/pants curve (measurement lines drawn directly on the master); textBox right edge (535) and support/wordmark stay well clear of the sock/feet product (starts ~x700).

MOL_IMG_005._rationale: The flat cabinet-front wood panel to her left (x0-~380) is the only usable negative space; it's narrower than IMG_001's rug, which is why the headline is smaller here — sized to what this photo actually offers, not forced to match another post. Box stops at y=1050 well above her socks (~y1150) and the block's actual bottom (862) lands nowhere near either boundary.

MOL_IMG_019._rationale: This photo's negative space is the plain wall in the top-left, not the bottom — placed there instead of forcing a bottom-anchored layout that doesn't exist in this frame. Box stops well above the plant leaves (~y540) and well left of her watering-can hand (~x420).
